description: Our team Ryoga his mother and Hinata is dedicated to solving the energy and water challenges brought by the region's massive AI data center boom. Inspired by real-world experiences with Atmospheric Water Generation (AWG) in Japan, we created the Aqua-Thermo Loop. By combining solar power, server heat recovery, and air-to-water technology, our solution eliminates blackouts, preserves local water, and empowers communities to thrive alongside next-generation AI infrastructure.
